item.title: Discuss Introduces Real-Time AI Translation for Observers
item.description: By embedding AI directly into live translation and study execution, Discuss equips teams to conduct multilingual research at scale without the structural cost and delay historically associated with global qualitative work.

item.title: Entravision Acquires Playback Rewards’ Technology to Boost Loyalty Advertising
item.description: The Playback assets will be incorporated into Adwake’s Rewarded & Loyalty advertising roadmap, supporting faster product innovation and expanded campaign capabilities across mobile environments.

item.title: Onetag Announces Acquisition of Aryel
item.description: With this acquisition, Onetag has taken a step toward reshaping digital advertising, from fragmented transactions and poor user experience to a unified value exchange built on quality, intelligence, and outcomes.

item.title: Picsart Introduces New ‘Faceless’ Tools: Persona and Storyline
item.description: The AI platform is introducing a dual toolset, Persona and Storyline, specifically designed to address the two main challenges in AI content creation: scaling narratives and character consistency.

item.title: Typeface Launches Marketing Orchestration Engine
item.description: Looking ahead, Typeface is extending orchestration into Arc Loop, a closed-loop system where marketing performance feeds directly back into how AI operates.

item.title: AppTweak Unveils AI Agents to Scale ASO & Apple Ads Performance
item.description: The launch introduces ASO Agent, Reviews Agent, and Reporting Agent, expanding AppTweak's AI offering across ASO analysis, app store reviews, and performance reporting.

item.title: Comscore, Yahoo DSP Partner to Launch Proximic Political Audiences
item.description: The partnership is designed to support leading political activation partners, including MiQ’s dedicated political division, enabling agencies and campaigns to operationalise Proximic Political Audiences at scale across premium CTV inventory.

item.title: Guideline Introduces Media Plan Management MCP Server
item.description: Built on the MCP, an open standard that has rapidly emerged as the universal language for agentic AI connectivity, the new server is available now and represents the first in a series of MCP capabilities from Guideline.

item.title: PulsePoint Integrates with Reddit to Expand HCP Advertising
item.description: Through PulsePoint's Audience Manager capability, healthcare marketers can create dynamic, verified HCP target lists to reach and engage with their target audiences on Reddit, built around clinical intent, digital interests, and brand relevance.

item.title: Sanity Launches AI Content Operating System
item.description: Built around three pillars — model your business, automate everything, and power anything — Sanity gives teams the structured foundation, automation layer, and agentic context to run AI in production.
